value.rationale: An exact complete two-parameter scheduling threshold for a natural exchange of contact intensity between communities is decision-relevant: it identifies exactly which duty cycles and switching periods make two separately supercritical contacts jointly subcritical, the largest allowable period, and how robust timing margins vanish. This specific boundary is not merely a small numeric example or an unnamed general inequality; model and stochastic limitations are explicit.
